verdict.rationale: Devin's API supports creating sessions programmatically, including on behalf of any org user, implying the ability to spin up multiple concurrent agent sessions for scaling delivery — but there's no explicit documentation of concurrency limits, dashboards, or throughput-oriented features for managing many parallel tasks, and community commentary raises doubts about Devin's real-world reliability (e.g., only 13.8% of issues resolved), which undercuts confidence in scaling delivery via parallel agents.
